title: ononis natrix var. villosa
intro: Ononis natrix var. villosa, commonly known as  Rough-leaved Restharrow or  Rough-leaved Burnet, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ononis natrix var. villosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
